name: The den
blurb: The cave is the short way, after the lamp. The ball is not.
aside: The stick at F3 is the corner of column F. The lamp is the dot in front of the cave. That line scores −10. The other walk leaves column F early, takes the ball at C8, skips the treat and the stick, and reaches the flag on the last point. It scores −11. The stick at B2 is two steps past that cave line, down to row 2 and back up at the flag. That walk scores −11 too.
